title_cn: 惊悚！外卖骑手送来的包裹竟藏婴儿遗骸 警方追捕前任女友
summary_cn: 一名泰国年轻男性遭遇恐怖事件：外卖骑手送来的包裹内装有婴儿遗骸。警方初步怀疑这是与其分手6-7个月的前任女友所为。案件已报警，警察正在展开调查和追捕工作，以查明事件真相。

desc: ซีพีแรมดันตลาดอาหารเจ 365 วัน รับเทรนด์กินเพื่อสุขภาพ เผยตลาดโต 9-10% มูลค่า 4.9 หมื่นล้าน ส่งอาหารเจเข้าเซเว่นฯ วันละกว่า 1 ล้านกล่อง ปรับสู่ Real Food ท้าทายซัพพลายเชน ตรึงราคาสู้ต้นทุน
title_cn: 正大食品推素食产品，日销百万盒
summary_cn: 正大集团（CP RAM）响应健康饮食趋势，大力推进素食市场，该市场年均增长9-10%，总规模达4.9万亿泰铢。公司每日通过便利店销售约100万盒素食产品，但面临原料成本上升压力，企业正通过优化供应链和稳定价格战略来应对挑战。

desc: วัน แบงค็อก จัด “ONE OKTOBERFEST” รับเทศกาลปลายปี รวมอาหารและเครื่องดื่มนานาชาติกว่า 34 ร้าน พร้อมคอนเสิร์ตศิลปินดัง ดนตรีสด และกิจกรรมฮาโลวีน ระหว่าง 28 ต.ค. – 1 พ.ย. 2569
title_cn: One曼谷购物中心举办「ONE OKTOBERFEST」美食节
summary_cn: One Bangkok（One曼谷）购物中心举办「ONE OKTOBERFEST」大型活动，汇聚34家国际美食和饮品餐厅，为消费者提供多元化美食体验。活动期间还将举办知名艺人演唱会、现场音乐表演和万圣节主题活动，活动时间为10月28日至11月1日。

title: รฟม.เร่งรถไฟฟ้า 3 สาย เปิดครบ 9 สีปี 73 จ่อเดินหน้าเฟส 2 อีก 4 เส้นทาง
desc: รฟม. ลุยสร้างรถไฟฟ้าใหม่ 4 สายทาง "น้ำตาล-เทา-เงิน-ฟ้า" ในปี 72 หลังสายสีส้มตะวันออก-ตก พ่วงสีม่วงใต้ เสร็จครบ เปิดใช้งานปี 73 หนุนคนกรุงเชื่อมต่อรถไฟฟ้าเฟสแรกครบ 9 สี รวม 279.84 กม.
title_cn: 泰国地铁加速扩建，9条线路2030年完全开通
summary_cn: 泰国地铁运营商BTS（Bangkok Mass Transit System）正加快推进地铁网络扩展，计划在2029年完成新增4条地铁线路——糖色线、灰色线、银色线和蓝色线。届时与既有的橙色东西线及紫色南线共同构建9条地铁线路的完整网络，总长度达279.84公里，显著改善首都交通连通性。
desc_original: รฟม. ลุยสร้างรถไฟฟ้าใหม่ 4 สายทาง "น้ำตาล-เทา-เงิน-ฟ้า" ในปี 72 หลังสายสีส้มตะวันออก-ตก พ่วงสีม่วงใต้ เสร็จครบ เปิดใช้งานปี 73 หนุนคนกรุงเชื่อมต่อรถไฟฟ้าเฟสแรกครบ 9 สี รวม 279.84 กม.

title: Bangkok meetings offer economic boost
desc: The IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings provided Thailand with an opportunity to showcase its cultural strengths, generate business activity and lay the foundations for longer-term economic gains, according to industry leaders.
title_cn: 曼谷国际会议为经济增长奠基
summary_cn: IMF（国际货币基金组织）与世界银行年度会议在曼谷举办，为泰国提供展现文化优势、发展商业机遇的平台。业界人士认为此次国际会议不仅能带动短期商业活动，更将为泰国长期经济增长奠定坚实基础，有助于提升泰国在国际经济舞台上的影响力。
desc_original: The IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings provided Thailand with an opportunity to showcase its cultural strengths, generate business activity and lay the foundations for longer-term economic gains, according to industry leaders.

title: Flying solo: the trend of living alone
desc: The growing number of single people in Thailand represents more than just a social change. Living alone is becoming a structural shift that is reshaping the Thai economy and ushering in a new era of consumption.
title_cn: 泰国独居浪潮重塑消费经济
summary_cn: 泰国单身人口不断增长，独居已经演变为一种结构性社会转变，而非简单的人口统计现象。这种趋势正在深刻重塑泰国经济和消费市场，标志着新的消费时代和商业模式的诞生，企业和产业需要适应这一新消费结构。
desc_original: The growing number of single people in Thailand represents more than just a social change. Living alone is becoming a structural shift that is reshaping the Thai economy and ushering in a new era of consumption.

title: AI agents emerge as growth driver
desc: Thailand's IT market is expected to receive a boost from government solar power projects in the fourth quarter, while growing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) agents could become a driver of enterprise IT spending next year, offsetting weak consumer purchasing power and rising hardware costs.
title_cn: AI 智能体成为增长引擎
summary_cn: 泰国信息技术市场预计在第四季度因政府太阳能项目获得提振，而人工智能（AI）智能体的采用增加有望成为明年企业 IT 支出的驱动力，抵消消费者购买力疲软和硬件成本上升的影响。
desc_original: Thailand's IT market is expected to receive a boost from government solar power projects in the fourth quarter, while growing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) agents could become a driver of enterprise IT spending next year, offsetting weak consumer purchasing power and rising hardware costs.

title: Dept opposes plan to open mine near world heritage site
desc: A conservation agency in Phetchaburi has opposed a proposed dolomite mine near Kaeng Krachan World Heritage Site, warning of potential harm to wildlife, water resources and local communities.
title_cn: 部门反对在世界遗产地附近开矿计划
summary_cn: 碧差汶府（Phetchaburi）保护机构反对在凯考卡炎世界遗产地（Kaeng Krachan World Heritage Site）附近开设白云石矿，警示可能对野生动物、水资源和当地社区造成危害。
desc_original: A conservation agency in Phetchaburi has opposed a proposed dolomite mine near Kaeng Krachan World Heritage Site, warning of potential harm to wildlife, water resources and local communities.

title: Dolphin conservation efforts broaden
desc: On the shores of Songkhla Lake, the survival of endangered Irrawaddy dolphins is tied to the livelihoods of the people who share their habitat.
title_cn: 海豚保护工作范围扩大
summary_cn: 松卡拉湖（Songkhla Lake）沿岸，濒危伊洛瓦底江豚（Irrawaddy dolphins）的生存与当地社群共享栖息地的生计紧密相连，多方保护合作日渐深化。
desc_original: On the shores of Songkhla Lake, the survival of endangered Irrawaddy dolphins is tied to the livelihoods of the people who share their habitat.

title: Ministry eyes extension to B40 promotion train tickets
desc: The Transport Ministry is considering extending the 40-baht all-day fare scheme for Bangkok's Red and Purple electric train lines beyond its Nov 30 expiry.
title_cn: 交通部考虑延长 40 铢地铁优惠票价方案
summary_cn: 曼谷运输部正考虑将红线和紫线电车 40 铢全天优惠票价方案延期至 11 月 30 日后继续实施，以促进公共交通使用并减轻乘客交通成本。
desc_original: The Transport Ministry is considering extending the 40-baht all-day fare scheme for Bangkok's Red and Purple electric train lines beyond its Nov 30 expiry.

title: Prachin Buri oil leak suspected
desc: The Pollution Control Department (PCD) is now testing water quality and preparing to contain oil slicks in Prachin Buri after a suspected oil film was detected, amid concerns it could reach the Prachin Buri River.
title_cn: 北碧府（Prachin Buri）疑似石油泄漏
summary_cn: 泰国污染管制部（PCD）检测到疑似油膜后，正在测试水质并准备清理北碧府油迹，担忧污染可能蔓延至北碧河，涉及饮用水安全和环境保护。
desc_original: The Pollution Control Department (PCD) is now testing water quality and preparing to contain oil slicks in Prachin Buri after a suspected oil film was detected, amid concerns it could reach the Prachin Buri River.

title: Investment takes centre stage after curtain falls
desc: Thailand's challenge involves turning international exposure into concrete investment projects that support the country's long-term competitiveness after hosting the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings, say executives.
title_cn: 国际曝光转化为实质投资成泰国当前挑战
summary_cn: 泰国刚刚主办IMF-世界银行年会，业界人士指出该国面临的关键挑战是将国际关注度转化为具体投资项目，以支撑长期竞争力。
desc_original: Thailand's challenge involves turning international exposure into concrete investment projects that support the country's long-term competitiveness after hosting the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings, say executives.

title: Restaurants promote  Thai delicacies
desc: The IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings offered a prominent platform to showcase Thai cuisine, says the president of the Thai Restaurant Association.
title_cn: 餐饮业借IMF-世界银行年会推介泰国美食
summary_cn: 泰国餐饮协会主席表示，IMF-世界银行年会为泰国美食提供了展示平台，有利于推广泰国饮食文化和餐饮业发展。
desc_original: The IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings offered a prominent platform to showcase Thai cuisine, says the president of the Thai Restaurant Association.

title: Call for wellness reforms as global demand rises
desc: As the government pinpoints medical and wellness services as a new economic growth engine, operators in this sector say several developments are needed for the country to fully benefit from the rising demand.
title_cn: 全球需求上升 业界呼吁推进医疗健康产业改革
summary_cn: 泰国政府将医疗和健康服务列为新的经济增长引擎，但产业从业者指出，该国需要进行多方面改革才能充分利用不断增长的国际需求，抓住产业发展机遇。
desc_original: As the government pinpoints medical and wellness services as a new economic growth engine, operators in this sector say several developments are needed for the country to fully benefit from the rising demand.

title: Monomax hopes to break even next year thanks to subscribers
desc: Jasmine International Plc (JAS) expects Monomax, the streaming platform under Mono Next, to break even next year as subscribers surge to 1.5 million from roughly 900,000.
title_cn: Monomax流媒体平台有望明年扭亏为盈
summary_cn: 茉莉花国际公司（JAS）旗下流媒体平台Monomax预期用户数将从约90万增至150万，基于订户增长势头，该平台有望在明年实现扭亏为盈。
desc_original: Jasmine International Plc (JAS) expects Monomax, the streaming platform under Mono Next, to break even next year as subscribers surge to 1.5 million from roughly 900,000.

title: Traders in Khlong Chan Flats rebuild after historic floods
desc: Small business owners in Khlong Chan Flats have reopened their shops after a week of severe flooding, but mounting debts and lost income are driving calls for urgent government assistance.
title_cn: 隆昌平民小区（Khlong Chan Flats）商户洪灾后重建
summary_cn: 曼谷隆昌平民小区商户在经历一周严重洪灾后已陆续重开店铺，但累积债务和收入损失促使他们呼吁政府提供紧急援助，帮助度过难关。
desc_original: Small business owners in Khlong Chan Flats have reopened their shops after a week of severe flooding, but mounting debts and lost income are driving calls for urgent government assistance.

title: Restaurants confront uncertain outlook
desc: The Thai restaurant industry anticipates an uneven recovery in the fourth quarter this year.
title_cn: 泰国餐饮业前景堪忧
summary_cn: 泰国餐饮行业对今年第四季度的经济复苏前景感到担忧，预期增长将呈现不均衡态势。面对消费者支出波动、劳动力成本上升等多重挑战，行业普遍预期复苏进程将较为缓慢且参差不齐。这种不确定性对从业人员和投资者带来考验。
desc_original: The Thai restaurant industry anticipates an uneven recovery in the fourth quarter this year.

title: TDRI warns of growth concentration in sectors
desc: Thailand's economy is experiencing uneven growth, in which some sectors and groups benefit while others fall behind, meaning ordinary people are not benefiting, says an economist at Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI).
title_cn: 泰国发展研究所警告经济增长集中在少数行业
summary_cn: 泰国发展研究所（TDRI）经济学家指出，泰国当前经济增长呈现不均衡态势，部分行业和社会群体获益明显，但其他群体相对落后，导致普通民众难以从经济增长中受益。这反映了增长红利分配不均的深层问题，需要政策层面的更多关注和调整。
desc_original: Thailand's economy is experiencing uneven growth, in which some sectors and groups benefit while others fall behind, meaning ordinary people are not benefiting, says an economist at Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI).

title: Rail travel to expand in 5 provinces
desc: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to expand rail-based public transport into five regional provinces, aiming to improve connectivity, attract investment and support economic growth beyond Bangkok.
title_cn: 轨道交通拟向5个省份扩展
summary_cn: 泰国大众快速运输局（MRTA）计划向五个地区省份扩展轨道交通网络，旨在改善区域连接、吸引外来投资并促进曼谷外围地区的经济增长。此项目是泰国长期基础设施发展战略的重要一环，将通过便利的交通条件为沿线地区创造更多发展机遇。
desc_original: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to expand rail-based public transport into five regional provinces, aiming to improve connectivity, attract investment and support economic growth beyond Bangkok.

title: Experts urge use of 'alternative data' for better credit checks
desc: As Asean's digital economy accelerates, policymakers and financial leaders are turning to alternative data as a tool to broaden access to credit for businesses and individuals excluded from traditional systems.
title_cn: 专家呼吁运用「替代数据」完善信用评估体系
summary_cn: 随着东盟数字经济加速发展，政策制定者和金融领导者转向利用替代数据技术，以扩大被传统信用系统排斥的企业和个人的信贷获取渠道。这一举措有助于推动金融包容性发展，让更多中小微企业和个人获得融资机会，是适应数字时代的重要金融创新方向。
desc_original: As Asean's digital economy accelerates, policymakers and financial leaders are turning to alternative data as a tool to broaden access to credit for businesses and individuals excluded from traditional systems.

title: Online gambling crackdown  deemed 'ineffective' by ex-MP
desc: Former Democrat Party MP Sirichoke Sopha has questioned the effectiveness of the Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry's crackdown on online gambling, claiming that five major betting websites remain accessible from Thailand despite the ministry's announcement that it had blocked 945,075 links.
title_cn: 前议员批评网络赌博打击行动「效果甚微」
summary_cn: 泰国民主党前议员西里猜·索帕（Sirichoke Sopha）质疑数字经济与社会部打击网络赌博的有效性。官方声称已阻止945,075个链接，但西里猜指出五家主要赌博网站仍可从泰国访问。这反映了网络监管与实际执行效果之间存在的差距，引发对政策有效性的讨论。
desc_original: Former Democrat Party MP Sirichoke Sopha has questioned the effectiveness of the Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry's crackdown on online gambling, claiming that five major betting websites remain accessible from Thailand despite the ministry's announcement that it had blocked 945,075 links.

title: World Bank loans $200m
desc: Thailand has secured US$200 million (6.7 billion baht) in World Bank financing for clean energy and low-carbon cities, turning its International Monetary Fund (IMF)-World Bank annual meetings into economic opportunities for businesses and communities.
title_cn: 世界银行向泰国提供2亿美元清洁能源融资
summary_cn: 泰国在国际货币基金组织与世界银行年会期间，成功获得世界银行2亿美元（约67亿泰铢）融资支持，用于推动清洁能源项目及低碳城市建设。此举为当地企业及社区创造了经济发展机遇，充分把握国际金融机构年会带来的合作机遇。
desc_original: Thailand has secured US$200 million (6.7 billion baht) in World Bank financing for clean energy and low-carbon cities, turning its International Monetary Fund (IMF)-World Bank annual meetings into economic opportunities for businesses and communities.

title: Thailand intercepts 7kg heroin in drink sachets bound for Australia
desc: Thailand intercepts 7kg heroin in drink sachets bound for Australia Legacy Thai police have seized around 7 kilogrammes of heroin hidden in drink sachets bound for Australia at a courier facility in Samut Prakan, along with more than 2.5 million yaba pills in a separate operation in Ratchaburi. The heroin seizure followed a tip-off about suspected drug shipments at a private courier facility in Samut Prakan, according to a report today, October 18. Investigators inspected two boxes. Both had sender details in Thailand and were addressed to recipients in Australia. Inside, officers found various brands of instant drink products, but noticed that the sachets felt unusually hard. Photo via เจาะลึกทั่วไทย Inside Thailand When they opened the packets, they discovered white powder wrapped in silver foil. A field test using Marquis reagent turned purple, indicating the presence of heroin. Police seized approximately 7.003 kilogrammes of the drug, classified as a Category 1 narcotic in Thailand, and transferred the evidence to Narcotics Suppression Bureau investigators. Officers are now working to identify the sender and other people involved in the attempted shipment of heroin bound for A

title: Suspects killed in Si Sakhon clash linked to earlier cases
desc: Suspects killed in Si Sakhon clash linked to earlier cases Legacy Three suspects were killed in an exchange of gunfire in Narathiwat’s Si Sakhon district yesterday, October 17, in a clash that also left one police officer dead and two paramilitary rangers wounded. Two of the dead had outstanding arrest warrants and have since been linked by DNA records to the earlier Khao Tawe clash, according to Thai-language reports. The shootout began at 11.30am at a house in Si Banphot subdistrict. Both sides opened fire, and Saroj Lodnuan, a patrol squad leader at Si Sakhon Police Station, was killed. Officials identified the dead as 30 year old Haseng Po-ma, 26 year old Abuasnan Chema and 56 year old Yu Kasae, who owned the house. Haseng was wanted over the bombing of a petrol station in Tanyong Mat subdistrict, Rueso district, on January 13. Abuasnan was wanted over the shooting of a married couple, Paisan and Sumon Jungsakul, in Rueso district on June 15, 2019. DNA data in the database links both Haseng and Abuasnan to the clash on Khao Tawe in Cho Airong district on September 9. However, officials are still checking the original forensic results. title_cn: 那拉提瓦枪战三嫌疑人丧生　DNA确认与旧案关联
summary_cn: 泰国那拉提瓦府（Narathiwat）四色港县（Si Sakhon）10月17日发生枪战，三名嫌疑人被击毙，警察巡逻队长沙罗吉（Saroj Lodnuan）牺牲，两名准军事护林员受伤。被击毙者中，30岁哈生曾因炸弹袭击被通缉，26岁阿布阿斯南曾因2019年枪杀夫妇被通缉。DNA记录已将两人与9月9日科艾松县（Cho Airong）考塔威镇（Khao Tawe）的冲突关联。
desc_original: Suspects killed in Si Sakhon clash linked to earlier cases Legacy Three suspects were killed in an exchange of gunfire in Narathiwat’s Si Sakhon district yesterday, October 17, in a clash that also left one police officer dead and two paramilitary rangers wounded. Two of the dead had outstanding arrest warrants and have since been linked by DNA records to the earlier Khao Tawe clash, according to Thai-language reports. The shootout began at 11.30am at a house in Si Banphot subdistrict. Both sides opened fire, and Saroj Lodnuan, a patrol squad leader at Si Sakhon Police Station, was killed. Officials identified the dead as 30 year old Haseng Po-ma, 26 year old Abuasnan Chema and 56 year old Yu Kasae, who owned the house. Haseng was wanted over the bombing of a petrol station in Tanyong Mat subdistrict, Rueso district, on January 13. Abuasnan was wanted over the shooting of a married couple, Paisan and Sumon Jungsakul, in Rueso district on June 15, 2019. DNA data in the database links both Haseng and Abuasnan to the clash on Khao Tawe in Cho Airong district on September 9. However, officials are still checking the original forensic results. title: Woman storms Buriram abbot’s quarters in jealous rant
desc: Woman storms Buriram abbot’s quarters in jealous rant Legacy A woman reportedly stormed into an abbot’s quarters at a temple in Buriram and shouted at him in a jealous rant, prompting villagers to call for an investigation. Villagers in Prasat subdistrict, Ban Kruat district, complained on 17 October about the incident, which was recorded in an audio clip. A 42 year old woman, who has not been named, is said to have confronted the abbot inside his residence. The clip reportedly captures the woman venting hurt and jealousy, suggesting the abbot had a new woman in his life. The claims have not been verified. 70 year old Kittiya Jampathong, a villager who visited the temple to make merit, said the woman shouted in the abbot’s quarters for about 30 minutes. She said the woman told him she was not afraid of hell and would go there with him. Kittiya also said she had heard the woman damaged items inside the residence. Kittiya said that when she asked the abbot about it, he told her the woman was drunk and should be ignored. title_cn: 武里南女子闯入寺庙住持房　因妒忌大闹三十分钟
summary_cn: 武里南府班格县普拉萨特副区一名42岁女性闯入寺庙住持房间，以妒忌为由大声指责住持约30分钟，并据称对房内物品进行破坏。村民称女性曾表示不害怕下地狱，愿意陪住持一起去。住持声称该女性酒醉应被忽视，但此回应引起村民疑虑。村民向有关部门投诉，要求对事件进行调查。

title: Thick white foam piles up in Pathum Thani canal as fish die
desc: Thick white foam piles up in Pathum Thani canal as fish die Legacy Thick masses of white foam have piled up across a canal in Pathum Thani, where residents are reporting black, foul-smelling water and fish beginning to die. Residents near Wat Lat Sanun in Lam Luk Ka district alerted reporters at around 7am today, October 18, after large amounts of white foam accumulated on the surface of Khlong 1, accompanied by a strong unpleasant smell. Reporters found several pumping stations channelling water directly into Khlong 1 from nearby streets and residential areas, including Bun Khum Road and Phun Phon housing estate in Lam Sam Kaeo municipality. Photo via Amarin TV The continuous flow of water was accompanied by large quantities of white foam spreading across the surface and collecting in thick patches. Residents expressed concern that the foam could contain chemicals or other harmful pollutants, drawing comparisons with previous reports of unexplained foam appearing elsewhere in Pathum Thani. title_cn: 巴吞他尼运河现大量白色泡沫　鱼群死亡污水恶臭
summary_cn: 巴吞他尼府林乐卡县卧庙水域1号水道出现大量白色泡沫堆积，伴有黑水和刺鼻恶臭。居民担忧泡沫含有有害化学物质。运河接收来自邦坤路和芬芬住宅区等地多个泵站的排水，大量鱼类在水面挣扎呼吸，部分已死亡。居民将此与此前巴吞他尼其他地区的类似事件进行比较，呼吁调查污染源头。

title: Call centre scam gang tells student to fake own kidnapping
desc: Call centre scam gang tells student to fake own kidnapping Legacy Police rescued a university student in Bangkok’s Phaya Thai area yesterday, October 17, after a call centre scam gang convinced them to hide in a rented room and stage a fake kidnapping to extort their parents for up to 300,000 baht (US$9,018). Pathumwan Police Station received a report from the student’s parents that the student had left their accommodation and tried to harm themselves. Officers traced the student to a dormitory in Soi Sasana at about 6pm. The student was still on the phone to the scammers, who hung up when police arrived. The scam began on October 16, when a caller posing as a mobile network employee claimed the student’s ID card had been used to open a phone number linked to fraud and money laundering. The caller correctly recited the student’s 13 digit ID number. The student was then passed to a fake provincial police officer, who ordered them into a Telegram chat room called the interrogation room. Under pressure to prove their innocence, the student transferred 36,000 baht to the gang. The gang told the student to rent a room by the day and switch phone numbers so family could not make contact.
title_cn: 曼谷诈骗集团骗学生「自导自演绑匪」　企图敲诈30万泰铢
summary_cn: 曼谷帕亚泰区一名大学生被电话诈骗集团欺骗，被指控使用虚假身份进行欺诈犯罪。诈骗分子冒充电信员工，准确背诵受害人13位身份证号，后转接假冒省级警察，将其纳入Telegram「审讯室」聊天组。学生在压力下先转账36000泰铢，后被指示租住日租房并更换电话号码，以隔断家庭联系并自导假绑匪案以敲诈父母最多30万泰铢。警方10月17日在索萨纳巷宿舍救出该学生，诈骗分子在警察到达时挂断电话。
